key_insight: MetaOPD learns token weights with a meta-objective so weighting decisions are optimized for how they improve the student after an update, rather than by a fixed heuristic.
engineering_relevance: This gives a practical way to make on-policy distillation more adaptive and robust for training smaller reasoning models in mathematical NLP systems.
method: Inner loop: update the student with weighted on-policy distillation.
Outer loop: update a lightweight token-weighting network using validation loss after a virtual student step.
Differentiate through the student update so token weights reflect post-update learning benefit.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on six mathematical reasoning and three out-of-domain datasets across two student sizes and seven baselines, with MetaOPD improving Avg@8/Pass@8 over OPD by 1.99/5.97 points for 0.6B and 2.25/6.41 points for 1.7B.
watch_item: Bilevel optimization adds training complexity and memory/compute overhead, so stable and efficient differentiation through the virtual update may be a practical implementation challenge.
paper_title: MetaOPD: Meta-Learned Token Weighting for On-Policy Distillation
